description: This file contains implementation of various lifecycle state handlers for a plugin in the WPEFramework, including states like Unloaded, Loading, Initializing, Paused, Active, Suspended, Hibernated, and Terminating. It manages application lifecycle transitions, interacts with runtime and window manager handlers, and uses Boost UUIDs for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Handles the unloaded state of the application lifecycle, currently always returns true.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Handles the loading state, generates a new application instance ID using UUID and signals loading completion.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Handles initialization, starts the runtime manager with launch parameters, and sets pending events.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Handles paused state, manages display rendering and lifecycle state transitions.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Handles active state, checks if rendering is ready and triggers first frame event.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Handles suspended state, manages wake-up or suspend actions, including display disable.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Handles hibernated state, manages hibernation via runtime handler.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Handles termination, kills or terminates the application via runtime handler and signals termination event.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the transition logic for each lifecycle state, interacting with runtime and window managers as needed.
